lines.en: I walk with iron in my arms
My steps clink as I go
I sway with every stride

lines.zh: 十六块铁换来的远程怪。
lines.en: Bought with sixteen iron, and it shoots.
I drag one foot behind
I shift the iron to my other arm
I step around a heap of seeds
I nod along as I walk
I stop in front of the stall
I lean my way toward you
I walk with my hands held up
I come out from behind the door
I stand holding my iron
I count the ingots in my arms
I tip my head at the stall
I lay the seeds in my palm
I open my mouth and close it
I stare at the eggs on the table
I rub the iron with my thumb
I wait for the stallkeeper to speak
I hold it up to look
I shift onto the other foot
I look up at the roof
I stack the ingots in a pile
I wait for the keeper to look my way
I count my goods leaning sideways
I tuck the seeds into my coat

lines.zh: 歪着头，我看你手里那半块。
lines.en: Head tilted, I eye the half in your hand.
You do not smell of iron
I lift the iron
Are you here to trade too

lines.zh: 我朝你晃了晃手里的东西
lines.en: I wave what I hold at you
You stand too near the stall
I got here first this time
Do you think this is enough
I open my mouth and nothing comes
I shift for a better throwing angle.
I point at the table
I hold the ingot up for you

lines.zh: 我在你和我之间看来看去
lines.en: I look between you and me
I pull my hand back a little
I drop what I am holding
I lean away
I hold where I was hit

lines.zh: 五十五点血，经不住几下。
lines.en: Fifty-five health does not last many blows.
I crouch to gather my goods
I grunt twice
I had not finished counting
My ingots roll away
Seeds are what I need
Do you have wheat seeds
I have iron, not enough seed
Will you trade? Two handfuls
I push the iron across
This count is not right
Let me see the seeds
I do not eat, I trade
Add a bit more seed
I count the ingots once more
You scatter my ingots
I crouch to pick them up
I sway twice and hold
An ingot lands on my foot
I gather it up and back off
You stepped on a seed
I never struck back
I straighten myself crookedly
That has spoiled my count
And I count again
I cannot even keep my accounts straight
I have not thought of it
I have only iron and seed
The stallkeeper does not deal in that
I would rather trade first
Will you come trade too
I could not explain it
I wave it off
And I go back to counting
I stoop and pick up an ingot
This one is muddy
I wipe it on my sleeve
I stack it on the others
I pick up a seed
I close my palm on the seed
I count what I hold
I will keep this one
I gather it all together
I nearly drop it again
I push the iron to the table's edge
Is this enough, do you think
I wait for you to nod
I spread the seeds out
I came a long way for this
I put my hand on the table
Count my goods, if you will
I hold up a number of fingers
I line the ingots up
I want to make this trade
I still have a few on me
Sixteen iron ingots buy one of me.
I count the ingots one by one
I line up what I hold
I reach for the egg on the table
I have counted the ingots again
I wait for the keeper to look up
You have not given me the seeds
I hold the iron in the air
This one is hard to hold
I step back a little
I guard it against my chest
I lay the ingots out on the table
My eyes stay on the eggs
I count the seeds halfway
I hold my hand above the table
I wait for you to push it over
I throw an ingot
I swing my arm and let fly
That one hits your shoulder
I flick a seed at you
That throw went wide
I gather everything up as a shield
I bump into you
I throw as I retreat
My hands are empty now
I flick a seed out

lines.zh: 有人拿铁和种子换了蛋
lines.en: Someone traded iron and seed for an egg
I come out of an egg
My ingots hit the ground first
I stand, leaning to one side
I lift my hands and look at me
I pop up beside the stall
I open my mouth and get the count wrong
The iron in my hands clatters down
I struggle out of the egg
I land and look at my own hands
I turn my head to the stall
I straighten my back a little
Everyone around is looking at me
The fire heats the iron I carry
I land with the ingots on top of me

lines.zh: 我抱着的东西把我压沉
lines.en: What I carry drags me under
My ranged attack never misses.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的铁锭上
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my ingot
Magic leaves me dizzy on my feet
I was busy trading and did not eat

lines.zh: 雷电顺着铁锭传到我身上
lines.en: The strike runs through my iron into me
I fall holding my iron
